title: MCOverlay
description: A Minecraft mod designed to give the feel of Steam overlay in Minecraft.
body:
# What is Minecraft Overlay?

Minecraft Overlay is a modern in-game overlay for Minecraft that lets you browse, multitask, and access useful tools without leaving the game.

The mod adds a clean desktop-style interface with draggable windows, widgets, notes, calculators, timers, themes, and an optional embedded browser system.

Designed to feel lightweight and modern, Minecraft Overlay focuses on convenience, customization, and usability while staying integrated directly into Minecraft.

# Features

Here is a basic rundown of what this mod does.

- Desktop-Style Overlay Interface
- Draggable & Resizable Windows
- Optional Embedded Browser
- Multi-Tab Browser Support
- Notes Widget
- Calculator Widget
- Timers & Productivity Tools
- Spotify Controls
- Custom Themes & UI Styling
- Smooth Modern Design
- Lightweight Overlay System

# Browser Support

The embedded browser feature uses MCEF Modern.

The mod itself works without MCEF installed. However, certain clients such as Feather Client have old version of CEF, so the browser functionality may be worse than others. 

# Modpack Permissions

This is a free project; you may include it in modpacks as long as proper credit and a link to the original project page are provided.

# Common Questions

- **Does this work on Fabric?**  
  Yes, the mod is built for Fabric.

- **Do I need MCEF installed?**  
  No, the mod already has MCEF built-in for the browser.

- **Can I use this without the browser?**  
  Yes. All non-browser overlay features still work normally.

- **Can I re-upload this mod?**  
  Please link to the official Modrinth or GitHub page instead of re-uploading.

- **Will more widgets/features be added?**  
  Yes. More customization, widgets, and overlay tools are planned.

# Support the Project

Minecraft Overlay is developed in my free time and will continue receiving updates, improvements, and new features over time.

If you enjoy the mod and want to support development, you can support the project here:

[☕ Buy Me a Coffee](https://buymeacoffee.com/shortieos)

Support helps with:

- New features and widgets

- Improving browser and overlay performance

Thank you for supporting the project ❤️
